sig: [[["A", "Today I'll walk you through TaskFlow, the project-tracking tool we're moving to next month."], ["A", "We've been using spreadsheets and e-mail threads, and things have been slipping through the cracks."], ["A", "First, open the link I sent this morning and sign in with your company account. You don't need to create a new password."], ["A", "On the left, you'll see your projects. Click on one, and you'll get a board with three columns: To Do, In Progress, and Done."], ["A", "To create a task, click the plus button, add a short title, and assign it to a team member."], ["A", "Make sure you always set a due date. Tasks without one won't show up in the weekly report."], ["A", "You can also attach files of up to twenty-five megabytes, but for anything bigger, please use a shared drive link."], ["A", "The old spreadsheets will be switched to read-only on the fifteenth, and they'll be archived completely at the end of the month."], ["A", "So any active tasks need to be moved into TaskFlow before the fifteenth."], ["A", "Now, I'll give you ten minutes to create two or three sample tasks of your own."], ["A", "If you get stuck, raise your hand and either Sam or I will come over."]], {"A": "F-AU"}]
